Goal: Ensure the client is introduced and understands the implementation context.
Actionable Items: Send introductory email from AE to client to introduce Gong implementation.

Goal: Ensure Gong instance exists and subscription is active.
Actionable Items: Create Gong account and verify subscription status.
Add users to Gong as business and technical admins.

Deliverables: Customer informed about implementation scope and timeline.
Actionable Items: Send implementation introductory email to customer contacts.

Deliverables: Internal kickoff scheduled or done asynchronously.
Actionable Items: Schedule internal kickoff call or share implementation context with AE/CSM.
Prepare implementation slide deck for customer kickoff.
Update implementation slide deck with info from internal kickoff / handoff.
Confirm primary Outcome with customer during kickoff and document in plan.
Confirm target go-live date with client.

Goal: Establish foundation for Gong (owners, cadence, governance, privacy).
Actionable Items: Identify core owners by function; confirm which individuals are accountable, responsible, and informed.
Select forecast cadence and implementation rhythm (e.g., weekly sprints; 30-day standard cycle).
Verify connection permissions across CRM, email/calendar, meeting platforms, and dialer.
Document sales motions and required workflows by motion (New Business, Renewal, Expansion).
Review and confirm compliance standards for recording, consent, data residency, and retention.
Book all implementation calls (Foundations, Engage, Forecast, Enablement) and hold times if needed.
Align on measurable success criteria by product (Foundations, Engage, Forecast) and document KPIs.
Review the Change Management Framework with customer; understand each team's existing pipeline management and coaching processes.

Goal: Connect Gong to core systems and data sources.
Actionable Items: Connect Gong to CRM via OAuth
test sync
review process of exporting data to CRM
if Salesforce, review Gong for Salesforce managed package.

Goal: Connect Gong to core systems and data sources.
Actionable Items: Set up web conferencing systems
configure native integrations (e.g., Zoom) and verify meeting capture.
Connect mail/calendar integration
confirm meetings created from email/calendar invites are captured.
Integrate telephony / dialer
confirm call tracking, user mapping, and recording configuration.
Review recording coverage report
confirm active recording for all enabled users and adjust as needed.
Test manual upload or API-based fallback for non-standard calls or legacy recordings.
Define and apply consent policy
review recording consent settings in Gong and align by region.
Configure data retention policies in Gong based on legal and security requirements.
Review permission profiles
assign roles
confirm data visibility for each persona.
Enforce restricted recording rules (users, teams, regions)
validate compliance with local regulations.
Enable and confirm admin log / audit trail settings in Gong.
Review and build out custom Keyword Trackers
enable default Smart Trackers aligned to target outcomes.
Build rep-level evaluation scorecards
review how to use scorecards once they are published.
Create deal review boards (Sales Pipeline, New Business, Renewals)
configure advanced deal board settings where applicable.
Organize call libraries and streams by team/motion
define content sharing rules and permissions.

Goal: Launch Gong tools and drive adoption.
Actionable Items: Deliver role-based training
establish champion network
announce go-live
set up adoption KPIs and dashboards
establish change control & governance cadence.
